name: site-sourcery
description: Site Sourcery customer site and held self-hosted product runtime.

scripts.check: npm run check:html && npm run check:routes && npm run check:vnext && npm run check:copy && npm run check:legal-copy && npm run check:catalog && npm run check:abracadabra
scripts.test:node: node --test scripts/test/site-vnext.test.mjs scripts/test/customer-copy.test.mjs scripts/test/legal-copy.test.mjs scripts/test/abracadabra-v1.test.mjs scripts/test/abracadabra-platform.test.mjs scripts/test/abracadabra-api.test.mjs scripts/test/abracadabra-commercial-control.test.mjs scripts/test/abracadabra-hosted-control.test.mjs scripts/test/hive-planner.test.mjs scripts/test/local-deliverable-downloads.test.mjs scripts/test/payment-provider-placeholder.test.mjs scripts/test/browser-release-gate.test.mjs scripts/test/domain-orchestration.test.mjs
scripts.check:selfhost: npm run runtime:selfhost && node --check src/*.mjs bin/*.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run runtime:check && npm run check && npm run test:node && npm run check:selfhost && npm run test:public-truth && npm run build:pages && npm run check:artifact && npm run audit:browser
